title: Twilight of the Apprentice
text: Reaction: After the Balance of the Force changes sides, draw 1 card.

title: Ezra Bridger
text:
While the Balance of the Force is with the light side, this unit gains edge (1).
While the Balance of the Force is with the dark side, this unit gains elite.

title: "Old Master"
text:
This unit cannot be committed to the Force.
While the Balance of the Force is with the dark side, this unit gains elite, targeted strike, and [Unit Damage].

title: Ezra's Lightsaber
text:
Enhance a Force User or Force Sensitive unit.
While the Balance of the Force is with the light side, enhanced unit cannot be targeted by enemy events.
While the Balance of the Force is with the dark side, enhanced unit gains [Unit Damage] ([Edge-enabled Tactics]).

title: Use Your Power
text:
[Jedi] resources cannot be used to pay the cost of this event.
Action: Set the Balance of the Force to the other side.

title: Echoes of the Force
text: You may commit a target unit to or remove a target unit from the Force.

title: The Broken Horn
text:
Elite.
X is the number of different affiliations among cards you control.

title: Cikatro Vizago
text:
Edge (1). Shielding.
This unit also has the Broken Horn affiliation.

title: IG-RM Bodyguard Droid
text: Reaction: After this unit enters play, search the top X cards of your deck for 1 card, add that card to your hand and place the others on the bottom of your deck in any order. X is the number of different affiliations among cards you control.

title: IG-RM Bodyguard Droid
text: Reaction: After this unit enters play, search the top X cards of your deck for 1 card, add that card to your hand and place the others on the bottom of your deck in any order. X is the number of different affiliations among cards you control.

title: Payback
text: Reaction: After 1 or more of your units survive an unopposed engagement as attackers, deal X damage to a target enemy unit. X is the number of different affiliations among cards you control.

title: Allies of Necessity
text: You may target 2 participating units you control that do not share an affiliation. If you do, one targeted unit gains [Unit Damage] and the other gains [Blast Damage] until the end of the engagement.

title: Order of Inquisitors
text: Reduce the cost of the first Inquisitor card you play each turn by 1.

title: The Seventh Sister
text:
Elite.
While this unit is attacking, instead of the normal edge battle, your opponent places any number of cards in his edge stack first, if desired. You place any number of cards in your edge stack, if desired. Reveal and resolve those edge stacks as normal.

title: The Fifth Brother
text:
Edge (1).
Reaction: After an Inquisitor unit leaves play, remove 1 focus token from this unit.

title: The Eighth Brother
text:
Shielding.
Interrupt: When this unit leaves play, deal 1 damage to a target unit.

title: Double-bladed Lightsaber
text:
Enhance an Inquisitor unit.
Enhanced unit gains [Unit Damage].
Action: Return enhanced unit and this enhancement to their owners' hand.

title: Press For Answers
text: Action: Look at the top X cards of your opponent's deck. Discard 1 of those cards and return the others to the top of the owner's deck in any order. X is the number of unique Character units you control.

title: Support of the Fleet
text: Action: Focus a Fighter unit to remove 1 focus token from a target non-[Imperial Navy] Vehicle unit. (Limit once per turn.)

title: Relentless
text:
Elite.
Reduce the cost of the first Fighter unit you play each turn by 1.
Each Fighter unit you control gains ([Blast Damage]).

title: TIE Escort
text: Protect non-[Imperial Navy] objective.

title: TIE Escort
text: Protect non-[Imperial Navy] objective.

title: Imperial Influence
text:
Enhance a resource generating card.
Enhanced card gains influence.
Reaction: After this enhancement enters play, draw 1 card.

title: Allies of Necessity
text: You may target 2 participating units you control that do not share an affiliation. If you do, one targeted unit gains [Unit Damage] and the other gains [Blast Damage] until the end of the engagement.

title: Double-Crossing Droid
text:
Scum and Villainy affiliation only.
Interrupt: When an event card is played, deal 2 damage to this objective to cancel that event card's effects.

title: 8t88
text:
Elite.
Reaction: After you play a non-[Scum and Villainy] event, draw 1 card. (Limit twice per turn.)

title: Twi'lek Sycophant
text: Reaction: After this unit enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an event card, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards back into your deck.

title: Secret Information
text:
Enhance your play area.
Influence.

title: Chain Reaction
text: Reaction: After a Reaction ability resolves, resolve its effect again as if you control the effect, ignoring any costs and trigger conditions. You may choose new target(s), if applicable.

title: Allies of Necessity
text: You may target 2 participating units you control that do not share an affiliation. If you do, one targeted unit gains [Unit Damage] and the other gains [Blast Damage] until the end of the engagement.
